title: The Ultimate Volatility Trading Week: 10 Leveraged ETFs for Bulls and Bears, November 16–20, 2026
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Key Takeaways

* Four major catalysts could create exceptional trading opportunities: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's Monday speech, NVIDIA's Tuesday earnings, Wednesday's FOMC minutes and anticipated Anthropic IPO pricing, and Thursday's Anthropic market debut and Trump–Xi–Putin summit.
* Day traders can position for either direction using 2× and 3× leveraged ETFs covering the Nasdaq-100, S&P 500, semiconductors, and energy. Bullish and bearish funds provide opportunities to trade confirmed trends without needing to short individual stocks.
* The 10 ETFs to watch:[ TQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/TQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ SQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/SQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ QLD](https://tickeron.com/stock/QLD/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ QID](https://tickeron.com/stock/QID/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ SOXL](https://tickeron.com/stock/SOXL/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ SOXS](https://tickeron.com/stock/SOXS/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ UPRO](https://tickeron.com/stock/UPRO/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ SPXU](https://tickeron.com/stock/SPXU/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ ERX](https://tickeron.com/stock/ERX/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), and[ ERY](https://tickeron.com/stock/ERY/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).
* Tickeron's Financial Learning Models (FLMs), [AI Trading Robots](https://tickeron.com/app/ai-robots/trending-robots/), AI Screener, AI Trading Signals, and new Ask AI feature can help traders investigate catalysts, evaluate momentum and reversals, and monitor systematic trading opportunities.
* The biggest danger is trading the headline rather than the market reaction. A positive announcement can still trigger selling, while negative news can spark a short-covering rally. Leveraged ETFs amplify both gains and losses.

The week of November 16–20 could be one of the most event-driven trading periods of the month. Inflation concerns, AI-sector uncertainty, a major technology IPO, geopolitical negotiations and Bitcoin's sharp decline are converging.

For active traders, the opportunity is not necessarily predicting whether the entire week will be bullish or bearish. It is identifying which events produce sustained directional moves and selecting instruments that match those moves.

# 1. What is confirmed — and what remains uncertain?

Several important details from the original market commentary can be verified.

|**Event or claim**|**Verification**|
|:-|:-|
|Warsh speech, Monday November 16|Confirmed by the Federal Reserve, scheduled for noon ET|
|90% probability of another rate hike|Not independently verified; should not be published as established fact|
|NVIDIA earnings, Tuesday November 17|Confirmed for approximately 1:20 p.m. PT, followed by a 2 p.m. PT call|
|Jensen Huang resignation|Confirmed by NVIDIA's SEC filing|
|NVIDIA commitments rising from $184B to $500B|Not sufficiently verified; avoid publishing the exact figures without the underlying filing|
|Anthropic IPO, November 19|Expected, according to its prospectus and Reuters reporting|
|Anthropic valuation up to $1.4T|Supported on a fully diluted basis at the upper end of the proposed price range|
|Trump–Xi–Putin meeting, November 19|Confirmed as scheduled by White House and Kremlin reporting|
|Bitcoin's sharp November selloff|Confirmed; however, its predictive value for next week's equities is unproven|

Sources include the Federal Reserve calendar, NVIDIA's November 12 announcement, Anthropic's preliminary prospectus, Reuters and CBS News.

Calendar: November 2026+6

The claim that two historical Sunday Bitcoin declines reliably predict a subsequent equity-market crash is particularly weak. Two selected examples are not enough to establish a dependable trading signal.

Bitcoin weakness is a risk indicator worth monitoring, not proof that stocks will crash.

# Which ETFs match the week's biggest themes?

TQQQ / SQQQ — AI and technology sentiment

These are useful instruments for trading broad Nasdaq-100 reactions to NVIDIA earnings, interest-rate expectations and AI-sector developments.

QLD / QID — Lower leverage for Nasdaq traders

The 2× pair provides less daily leverage than TQQQ/SQQQ. It may appeal to traders seeking smaller amplified exposure, although the risks remain substantial.

SOXL / SOXS — Semiconductor volatility

These provide more concentrated exposure to semiconductor stocks. They may be particularly sensitive to NVIDIA's results and management commentary.

UPRO / SPXU — Broad-market reactions

These track leveraged daily movements in the S&P 500, making them relevant when macroeconomic or geopolitical news affects multiple sectors simultaneously.

ERX / ERY — Energy and geopolitical developments

These provide leveraged exposure to energy equities, not crude oil directly. They may respond to changing oil-price expectations, geopolitical risk and energy-sector sentiment.

# 3. Day-by-day trading playbook: November 16–20

MON **16** NOV

Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh speaks 12:00 p.m. ET / 9:00 a.m. PT

The Fed Chair's remarks come as investors reassess inflation and the possibility of tighter monetary policy. The scheduled appearance is opening remarks at a productivity and jobs conference, so traders should not assume a major policy announcement.

Bullish scenario: Dovish comments or a market interpretation that reduces rate-hike concerns could favor[ TQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/TQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ QLD](https://tickeron.com/stock/QLD/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Bearish scenario: Hawkish surprises, rising Treasury yields and declining Nasdaq futures could favor[ SQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/SQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ QID](https://tickeron.com/stock/QID/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Trading approach: Watch the Nasdaq-100, 2-year Treasury yield and the first 15–30 minutes following the remarks. Look for confirmation across rates and equities before choosing a direction.

TUE **17**NOV NVIDIA earnings — the semiconductor stress test Results: \~1:20 p.m. PT / Earnings call 2:00 p.m. PT

[NVIDIA (NVDA)](https://tickeron.com/stock/NVDA/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) reports following Jensen Huang's resignation. Revenue growth, forward guidance, AI infrastructure spending, gross margins, customer concentration and management continuity are key areas to watch.

Bullish scenario: Strong guidance and reassuring management commentary could support semiconductor sentiment, making[ SOXL](https://tickeron.com/stock/SOXL/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) a candidate for a confirmed upward move.

Bearish scenario: Disappointing guidance or concerns about demand quality and customer financing could pressure chipmakers, potentially favoring[ SOXS](https://tickeron.com/stock/SOXS/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Trading approach: Because results arrive after the regular stock-market session, the clearest ETF trading opportunity may emerge Wednesday morning. Watch[ AMD](https://tickeron.com/stock/AMD/?utm_source=chatgpt.com),[ AVGO](https://tickeron.com/stock/AVGO/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), and semiconductor-sector breadth to determine whether NVIDIA's reaction is spreading.

NVIDIA's release time and leadership transition are confirmed by its investor announcement.

NVIDIA Newsroom+1

WED **18** NOV

NVIDIA reaction, FOMC minutes and anticipated Anthropic IPO pricing FOMC minutes: 2:00 p.m. ET / 11:00 a.m. PT

Wednesday may combine a full-session reaction to NVIDIA earnings with renewed monetary-policy scrutiny.

Anthropic's IPO is also expected to price ahead of its planned Thursday debut, although final timing and pricing remain subject to change.

Bullish scenario: Strong semiconductor participation and reassuring Fed minutes could favor[ TQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/TQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ SOXL](https://tickeron.com/stock/SOXL/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Bearish scenario: Weak chip-sector breadth combined with hawkish policy interpretations could favor[ SQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/SQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ SOXS](https://tickeron.com/stock/SOXS/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Trading approach: Separate the morning semiconductor reaction from the afternoon Fed event. A profitable morning setup can reverse after the minutes. Avoid assuming one signal will remain valid throughout the session.

The FOMC minutes are confirmed on the Federal Reserve's official calendar.

Calendar: November 2026

THU **19** NOV

Anthropic IPO and Trump–Xi–Putin summit

Two separate catalysts could influence risk appetite.

Catalyst A: Anthropic IPO

Anthropic plans to list under[ ANT](https://tickeron.com/stock/ANT/?utm_source=chatgpt.com), with an indicated offering range of 70–78 per share. Its potential $1.4 trillion fully diluted valuation makes demand for the offering a significant test of AI-investor sentiment.

Strong debut: If Anthropic attracts demand and the wider AI sector rallies,[ TQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/TQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ QLD](https://tickeron.com/stock/QLD/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) may be relevant.

Weak debut: If the IPO struggles and other AI stocks decline,[ SQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/SQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ QID](https://tickeron.com/stock/QID/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) may be relevant.

Catalyst B: U.S.–China–Russia meeting

The scheduled trilateral summit in Shenzhen includes discussions involving Iran and nuclear arms control. Trade and export-control sentiment may also react to developments.

De-escalation or improving trade sentiment: Could support broad equities, making[ UPRO](https://tickeron.com/stock/UPRO/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) worth monitoring.

Escalation or renewed geopolitical tension: Could pressure broad equities, making[ SPXU](https://tickeron.com/stock/SPXU/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) relevant. If energy equities rally with oil prices,[ ERX](https://tickeron.com/stock/ERX/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) could also attract attention; if they weaken,[ ERY](https://tickeron.com/stock/ERY/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) provides the opposite daily exposure.

Trading approach: Avoid treating an oil-price spike as an automatic buy signal for energy stocks. Check whether the energy equity benchmark confirms the move.

The Anthropic IPO is proposed, not completed. The summit is scheduled, and diplomatic outcomes remain uncertain.

Anthropic+2

FRI **20** NOV

Weekly trend confirmation — or reversal

Friday may reveal whether the week's volatility produced a durable trend or a series of short-lived reactions.

Bullish scenario: Strong breadth, stable yields and sustained buying in technology could favor[ TQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/TQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ UPRO](https://tickeron.com/stock/UPRO/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Bearish scenario: Continued selling, deteriorating breadth and failed rebounds could favor[ SQQQ](https://tickeron.com/stock/SQQQ/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) or[ SPXU](https://tickeron.com/stock/SPXU/?utm_source=chatgpt.com).

Trading approach: Compare price action with the week's highs and lows. Failed breakouts, reversals and position unwinding can become especially important heading into the weekend. Closing intraday positions before the weekend avoids weekend holding exposure.

# 4. How day traders can approach leveraged ETFs

A leveraged ETF can generate a large gain from a relatively small movement in its underlying benchmark, but losses are amplified in the same way.

For illustration, consider a hypothetical one-day move, before fees and tracking differences:

|**Underlying index move**|**+2× ETF**|**−2× ETF**|**+3× ETF**|**−3× ETF**|
|:-|:-|:-|:-|:-|
|\+2%|\+4%|−4%|\+6%|−6%|
|−2%|−4%|\+4%|−6%|\+6%|
|\+4%|\+8%|−8%|\+12%|−12%|
|−4%|−8%|\+8%|−12%|\+12%|

These are simplified daily targets, not forecasts or guaranteed outcomes.

# A practical framework for volatile sessions

1. Identify the catalyst. Know whether the market is reacting to monetary policy, earnings, IPO demand or geopolitics.
2. Wait for confirmation. Evaluate the underlying benchmark, trading volume, market breadth and whether the initial move holds.
3. Match the ETF to the catalyst. Semiconductor news may favor SOXL/SOXS, while broad macroeconomic surprises may favor UPRO/SPXU.
4. Size the position for leverage. A 3× fund can experience substantially larger daily losses than its benchmark. Smaller dollar exposure does not automatically make it safe.
5. Define an exit before entering. Set a maximum acceptable loss, reassess when the thesis changes, and avoid treating a losing intraday trade as a long-term investment.

Traders should also account for bid-ask spreads, stop-order slippage, trading halts, and gaps. A stop order cannot guarantee an execution price.

# 6. The most important lesson: trade the reaction, not the prediction

A hawkish Fed speech does not guarantee a stock-market decline.

Strong NVIDIA earnings do not guarantee a semiconductor rally.

A successful Anthropic IPO does not guarantee a technology-sector recovery.

And a sharp Bitcoin selloff does not establish that the S&P 500 will crash the following week.

Markets move relative to expectations, positioning, liquidity and the information already reflected in prices.

For day traders, the advantage may come from recognizing a confirmed directional move early, managing risk carefully, and avoiding emotional decisions during fast-changing conditions.

The week of November 16–20 presents multiple opportunities to evaluate both bullish and bearish setups. Leveraged ETFs make it possible to express either view, while AI-powered tools can help traders monitor markets and evaluate potential signals.

The goal should not be to predict every headline correctly.

It should be to maintain a disciplined process when the market's direction becomes clearer.
